findings.highlight: was waiting for me to clean up after breakfast and go to school
findings.evidenceJa: 朝食の後片づけをして俺が登校するのを待っていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura cleaned up breakfast herself and waited for Shirou to leave for school.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou the one Sakura waits to perform the cleanup, reversing her household action.

findings.highlight: I’m not crazy enough to do anything unnecessary.
findings.evidenceJa: 必要ないモノを作るほど酔狂じゃないぞ
findings.governingReading: Shirou is not eccentric enough to make Rin a key she does not need.
findings.explanation: Anything broadens the joke from producing a needless key to all unnecessary conduct.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka looks away.
findings.evidenceJa: ふん、と顔を逸らす遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin turns her face away with an angry huff.
findings.explanation: The audible irritation disappears from a gesture Shirou immediately finds flavorful.

findings.highlight: this gesture of Tohsaka’s is interesting too
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂のこういう仕草も味がある
findings.governingReading: Shirou begins to appreciate the distinctive charm or flavor of Rin’s reactions.
findings.explanation: Interesting is emotionally neutral and weakens the shift in his perception of her.

findings.highlight: make Tohsaka and Sakura be friends
findings.evidenceJa: 桜にも遠坂と仲良くしてもらわないといけないか
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks he may need Sakura to get along with Rin.
findings.explanation: Make them be friends overstates both mutuality and coercion in his tentative thought.

findings.highlight: It seems Sakura knows what Tohsaka wants to ask about.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂先輩が訊いているのはそういうコトじゃないと思いますけど
findings.governingReading: Sakura says Shirou has misunderstood Rin’s question.
findings.explanation: The English adds narrator confirmation of Sakura’s knowledge absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: am I acting weird to your eyes as well?
findings.evidenceJa: やっぱり桜から見てもヘン？
findings.governingReading: Rin asks whether Sakura also sees something wrong with her appearance.
findings.explanation: Acting weird changes her appearance anxiety into concern about behavior.

findings.highlight: It’s not my fault if you can’t sleep, sleep in an unfamiliar place
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が寝なれないのは俺の所為じゃない
findings.governingReading: It is not Shirou’s fault that Rin is unused to sleeping there.
findings.explanation: Two phrasings are fused, repeating sleep and damaging the condition.

findings.highlight: I thought I had this school thing mastered since I’ve been here for ten years now
findings.evidenceJa: 十年も通ってれば学校なんてマスターしたつもり
findings.governingReading: After attending school for ten years, Rin thought she had mastered school life.
findings.explanation: Been here can claim ten years at this particular school rather than accumulated schooling.

findings.highlight: just to ignore praise
findings.evidenceJa: 賛美を当然のようにスルーする
findings.governingReading: Rin takes the compliment for granted and lets it pass without reaction.
findings.explanation: Just to ignore is grammatically ill-fitted to the narrator’s incredulous question.

findings.highlight: a familiar face, coming through the students
findings.evidenceJa: 登校する生徒たちを邪魔そうに押しのけてくる
findings.governingReading: Shinji pushes arriving students aside as nuisances while advancing.
findings.explanation: The aggressive physical conduct and contempt for the crowd disappear.

findings.highlight: Catch his hand and greet him.
findings.evidenceJa: 掴んで止めて挨拶をした
findings.governingReading: Shinji raises a hand toward Sakura; Shirou catches and stops it while greeting him.
findings.explanation: The interception is split into fragments, weakening the simultaneity of restraint and casual greeting.

findings.highlight: YouI see, you went to Emiya’s house again
findings.evidenceJa: おまえそうか、また衛宮の家に行ってたのか
findings.governingReading: Shinji breaks off, realizes Sakura went to Emiya’s house again, and accuses her.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses You and I.

findings.highlight: a guy who hurt himself
findings.evidenceJa: 勝手に怪我したヤツ
findings.governingReading: Shinji contemptuously calls Shirou someone who got injured on his own account.
findings.explanation: Hurt himself can imply deliberate self-injury rather than dismissing an injury as self-incurred.

findings.highlight: So what if Emiya lives alone? doesn’t have parents?
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮が独り住まいだからなんだって言うんだ
findings.governingReading: Shinji asks why Emiya living alone should matter.
findings.explanation: mirror moon prints an additional parentlessness variant, sharpening the attack with content absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: Shinji tries to grab Sakura forcefully
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二はそんな桜を強引に連れて行こうとし
findings.governingReading: Shinji tries to force the frozen Sakura to go with him.
findings.explanation: Grab inserts a specific act and loses the controlling attempt to take her away.

findings.highlight: Sorry for eavesdropping
findings.evidenceJa: 黙って聞いていたんだけど
findings.governingReading: Rin says she listened silently and found the exchange interesting.
findings.explanation: The English invents an apology that is contrary to her controlled public attack.

findings.highlight: HuhToh… saka?
findings.evidenceJa: え遠、坂？
findings.governingReading: Shinji stammers Rin’s name in shock.
findings.explanation: The reaction and name are fused into HuhToh.

findings.highlight: I know him well enough
findings.evidenceJa: 知り合い
findings.governingReading: Rin repeatedly calls Shirou an acquaintance while implying regular shared travel.
findings.explanation: Know him well enough abandons the deliberately modest public label.

findings.highlight: I must be just imagining
findings.evidenceJa: 気のせいか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether the killing intent beyond hostility is his imagination.
findings.explanation: Must makes his uncertainty a confident dismissal.

findings.highlight: we’re detached now. So there isn’t much point in that approach
findings.evidenceJa: もう衛宮と僕は無関係だから、あまりメリットはないんだぜ
findings.governingReading: Shinji assumes Rin is using Shirou as a route to him, then says the ended friendship removes that advantage.
findings.explanation: Detached is nonidiomatic and that approach leaves the imagined direction of manipulation unclear.

findings.highlight: Uhshut up!
findings.evidenceJa: ううるさいな
findings.governingReading: Shinji stammers into an angry command.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses Uh and shut.

findings.highlight: glares at me and Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 忌々しそうに俺と桜を睨み付ける
findings.governingReading: Shinji glares at Shirou and Sakura with bitter resentment.
findings.explanation: The emotional quality of the glare disappears.

findings.highlight: Sakura lowers her head apologetically.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は俺だけではなく、遠坂にも謝っているのだろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou infers Sakura’s spoken apology includes Rin as well as himself.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a bowing or lowered-head action absent from the source.

findings.highlight: My mind went up a gear
findings.evidenceJa: 頭のギアがスパッと上がった
findings.governingReading: Rin says the argument snapped her mental gears cleanly into a higher state.
findings.explanation: Mind went up a gear is malformed and loses the crisp shift.

findings.highlight: Ahyes.
findings.evidenceJa: あはい
findings.governingReading: Sakura hesitantly agrees.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses Ah and yes.

findings.highlight: Sakura must be relieved, as she smiles cheerfully.
findings.evidenceJa: 安心したのか、嬉しそうに微笑む桜
findings.governingReading: Perhaps relieved, Sakura smiles happily.
findings.explanation: Must promotes the narrator’s tentative reading into fact.

findings.highlight: I know we’ll get to know each other better someday
findings.evidenceJa: 何かの拍子でまた付き合いが深くなるのは目に見えてる
findings.governingReading: Shirou expects that some turn of events will inevitably draw him and Shinji close again.
findings.explanation: Someday makes reconciliation a vague planned future and loses the accidental trigger and renewed relationship.

findings.highlight: Yesplease give him your best regards, Senpai.
findings.evidenceJa: はいよろしくお願いします、先輩
findings.governingReading: Sakura asks Shirou to continue dealing patiently with Shinji.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses Yes and please.

findings.highlight: I see. You are full of enmity too, for a different reason.
findings.evidenceJa: な、何故に遠坂と一緒にいるのか衛宮士郎
findings.governingReading: Issei cries out on seeing Shirou with Rin.
findings.explanation: The English inserts an explanatory narrator line about enmity absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: It’s good to have less people involved.
findings.evidenceJa: 関わる人間は少ないに越した事はない
findings.governingReading: For Shirou’s covert work, fewer people involved is better.
findings.explanation: Countable people incorrectly takes less instead of fewer.
